attr.desc: An orbital chain shooter. A chain of glowing orbs rolls toward a black hole: shoot orbs from the energy core to make groups of three of a color, close the gaps for chain reactions and charge the core before the chain is swallowed. Journey across six sectors, Endless and a Daily Orbit, level goals, 116 achievements and 100 unlockable cosmetics. Every image, sound and note of music is generated by the game. In English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Portuguese and Dutch.
